annotations.title: Sweep a domain across its authoritative servers

description: After a zone change: each nameserver's answer to each name and type, the disagreements, lame or silent servers, CAA and ACME readiness.

domain.description: The zone or name to sweep, e.g. example.com. Also as "name"; a URL is read as its host.

names.description: Relative labels to ask, "@" for the apex. Default: @, www, _dmarc, _acme-challenge

types.description: Record types. Default: SOA, NS, A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CAA

name: sweep_domain
title: Sweep a domain across its authoritative servers
